title: US Power Demand to Hit Record 4,356 Billion kWh by 2027
summary:
The Energy Information Administration forecasts that electricity consumption across the United States will grow throughout the next few years, driven by the surge in artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency data centers. Total power demand is projected to climb from 4,195 billion kWh in 2025 to 4,356 billion kWh by 2027, with consumption reaching record peaks in both 2026 and 2027.

The shifting energy mix will see the generation share of renewables reach 27% by 2027. In the same period, the share of power provided by coal is projected to drop to 15%.

selectedTweets.text:
U.S. POWER DEMAND TO HIT RECORD HIGHS ON AI BOOM

U.S. electricity consumption is projected to reach record highs in both 2026 and 2027, driven partly by growing demand from AI and crypto data centers, according to the EIA.

Power demand is expected to rise from 4,195 billion kWh in 2025 to 4,356 billion kWh in 2027.

Renewables’ generation share is projected to reach 27% by 2027, while coal falls to 15%.
